run_touchvit_depth_prediction: run the TouchVIT main entry point to predict depth maps from input images using Hydra config
create_touchvit_instance: create a TouchVIT instance with a Hydra DictConfig to load a DPTModel for tactile depth estimation
convert_image_to_heightmap: convert a single image array to a depth heightmap tensor using TouchVIT image2heightmap method
run_touchvit_batch_inference: run batch inference on up to 10 input images and display a collage of originals with depth predictions
review_touchvit_class: review the TouchVIT class that wraps a DPTModel for image to 3D depth map prediction
